title: Xaggee Ku Jira Faylasha La Soo Dejiyay? Hage Android iyo iPhone
description: Faylka aad soo dejisay ma heli la'dahay? Ogow meesha uu galo Android, iPhone, iPad iyo kombiyuutarka, iyo sida fiidiyowga loogu wareejiyo Gallery-ga.
photoCaption: Goobta faylasha way ku kala duwan tahay Android iyo iPhone.
photo2Caption: Laptop-ka, faylashu waxay galaan galka Downloads.
body:
Waxaad riixday badhanka soo dejinta, laakiin fiidiyowga kama heli kartid Gallery-ga? Ha welwelin, tani waa dhibaato aad u caadi ah. Inta badan faylku horeba wuu u kaydsan yahay, kaliya wuxuu ku jiraa gal ka duwan kan aad filaysay. Hagahan wuxuu sharxayaa meesha faylasha la soo dejiyay lagu kaydiyo ee Android, iPhone, iPad, iyo kombiyuutarka, iyo sida loo wareejiyo si ay u fududaato in la furo.

Sharaxaadda hoose waxay khusaysaa faylasha aad ku soo dejisay browser-ka, oo ay ku jiraan fiidiyowyo, cod, iyo sawirro ka yimid I Need Save. Faylasha si toos ah ayaa looga soo diraa barxadda asalka ah ilaa qalabkaaga, laguma kaydiyo server-ka I Need Save, sidaas darteed nuqulku wuxuu ku jiraa oo keliya taleefankaaga ama laptop-kaaga.

Goobta faylasha la soo dejiyay ee Android

Android, faylasha browser-ka lagu soo dejiyo waxay galaan galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada). Sida loo furo:

  1. Fur app-ka maamulka faylasha ee taleefankaaga. Magaciisu wuu kala duwan yahay iyadoo ku xiran nooca taleefanka, tusaale ahaan My Files, Files, ama File Manager.
  2. Dooro Soo dejisyada ama Downloads.
  3. U kala horreysii taariikhda ugu dambeysay si faylasha aad hadda soo dejisay ay u noqdaan kuwa ugu sarreeya.
  4. Taabo faylka si uu u daaro, ama taabo oo hay si aad u wareejiso, magac cusub ugu bixiso, ama u wadaagto.

Hab kale oo dhakhso badan: fur menu-ga browser-ka, kadibna dooro qaybta soo dejinta (Downloads). Halkaas waxaa ku yaal liiska faylasha aad hadda kaydisay, waxaadna si toos ah uga furi kartaa halkaas.

Maxaa fiidiyowgu weli uga soo muuqan waayay Gallery-ga?

App-ka Gallery mararka qaarkood waqti yar ayuu u baahan yahay si uu u baaro faylasha cusub. Haddii fiidiyowgu weli muuqan waayo, wax yar sug, kadibna xir oo dib u fur app-ka Gallery. Taleefannada qaarkood, fiidiyowyada galka Download waxaa lagu muujiyaa album gooni ah oo la yiraahdo Download ama Downloads, sidaas darteed sidoo kale eeg liiska album-yada.

Goobta faylasha la soo dejiyay ee iPhone iyo iPad

iPhone iyo iPad, faylasha Safari lagu soo dejiyo si toos ah uma galaan app-ka Photos. Waxaa lagu kaydiyaa app-ka Files (Faylasha) galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada).

Si fiidiyowga looga daawado app-ka Photos, raac tallaabooyinkan:

  1. Fur app-ka Files.
  2. Gal galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada).
  3. Taabo fiidiyowga aad rabto inaad wareejiso ilaa uu furmo.
  4. Taabo badhanka Share (La wadaag).
  5. Dooro Save Video (Kaydi Fiidiyowga).

Kadib fiidiyowgu wuxuu ka soo muuqan doonaa app-ka Photos isagoo la jira fiidiyowyada kale. Sawirrada, tallaabooyinku waa isku mid: ka fur sawirka Files, taabo Share, kadibna dooro doorashada lagu kaydiyo sawirka.

Marka fiidiyowga si guul leh loogu kaydiyo Photos, waad tirtiri kartaa nuqulka ku jira galka Downloads si kaydka iPhone-kaagu u ahaado mid bannaan.

Goobta faylasha la soo dejiyay ee laptop-ka iyo kombiyuutarka

Windows iyo Mac labadaba, faylasha browser-ka lagu soo dejiyo inta badan waxay galaan galka Downloads (Soo dejisyada).

  • Windows: fur File Explorer, kadibna guji Downloads ee guddiga bidix.
  • Mac: fur Finder, kadibna dooro Downloads ee sidebar-ka.
  • Browser-ka: fur liiska soo dejinta ee browser-ka. Chrome-ka Windows, tusaale ahaan, waxaad riixi kartaa Ctrl+J.

Haddii aad weligaa beddeshay dejinta browser-ka si faylasha loogu kaydiyo gal kale, ka hubi galkaas dejinta soo dejinta ee browser-kaaga.

Xaggee lagu kaydiyaa faylasha codka iyo sawirrada?

Goobtu waa la mid tan fiidiyowyada. Codka, ha ahaado tayadiisa asalka ah ama MP3 192 kbps ah oo laga beddelay fiidiyowga, wuxuu galaa galka Downloads. Sidoo kale sawirrada iyo sawirrada yaryar. Android, faylasha MP3 inta badan waxaa laga daari karaa maamulaha faylasha ama app-ka muusigga. iPhone, faylasha codka si toos ah ayaa looga daari karaa app-ka Files.

Haddii aad rabto inaad ogaato sida codka looga qaado fiidiyowga, akhri hagaha sida fiidiyowga baraha bulshada loogu beddelo MP3.

Gabi ahaanba fayl ma jiro? Hubi waxyaabahan

  • Soo dejintu weli ma dhammaan. Fiidiyowyada qaarkood marka hore waa in la habeeyaa, badhankuna wuxuu muujinayaa Waa la diyaarinayaa…. Sug ilaa soo dejintu si toos ah u bilaabato, bogganna ha xirin goor hore.
  • Kaydku waa buuxaa. Haddii kaydku ku dhow yahay inuu dhammaado, soo dejintu way guuldareysan kartaa. Meel yar bannee oo mar kale isku day.
  • Nuxurka lama soo dejin karo. Nuxurka gaarka ah, nuxurka u baahan gelitaan, ama nuxurka gobol ahaan loo xaddiday dhab ahaan lama kaydin karo.

Haddii aad heshay faylka laakiin uusan daarmayn, xalka ka eeg maqaalka fiidiyowga la soo dejiyay ma shaqaynayo.

Hal shay oo kale: nuxurka u kaydi kaliya isticmaal shakhsi ah oo ixtiraam xuquuqda daabacaadda abuurayaasha. Haddii aad rabto inaad dib u daabacdo, marka hore ogolaansho weydiiso oo xus magaca sameeyaha.

Su'aalaha inta badan la is weydiiyo

Goobta lagu kaydiyo faylasha la soo dejiyay ma la beddeli karaa?

Kombiyuutarka, browser-yada badankood waxay kuu oggolaanayaan inaad doorato galka soo dejinta menu-ga dejinta. Taleefanka, doorashadani waxay ku xiran tahay browser-ka iyo nidaamka aad isticmaalayso.

Maxaa iPhone-ka fiidiyowgu si toos ah ugu geli waayaa Photos?

Safari waxay faylasha la soo dejiyay ku kaydisaa app-ka Files. Waa inaad fiidiyowga ka furto Files, taabato Share, kadibna doorato Save Video.

Faylashayda ma lagu kaydiyaa server-ka I Need Save?

Maya. Faylasha si toos ah ayaa looga soo gudbiyaa barxadda asalka ah ilaa qalabkaaga, sidaas darteed si fiican u kaydi faylasha muhiimka ah.
